messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@fastinfra.com>, accounts@fastinfra.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Payment orchestration & supplier activation: Net terms sync

Hi Elena / FastInfra AP team,

Great to have FastInfra moving through vendor setup — welcome aboard. I want to align on a couple of operational items so we can finalize PO activation and ensure invoices route without delay: 

- Preferred invoice cutoff day (month-end vs. specific cut date)
- Confirm target payment term (Net30 / Net45 / Net60) and whether your AP team needs a specific invoice header or PO placement rule (e.g., PO in subject vs. PO in PDF body)
- Any early-pay program interest? We can offer an early payment enrollment (1% for net15) as a pilot for strategic partners.

Attached: stubbed copies of W9 and our MAA for signature. Also attaching a short PO_Workflow_Spec I use to map fields into our AP system. Can you confirm the points above and re-send any signed docs if helpful?

Next steps I propose after your confirmation: Monica will create the vendor profile in our intake portal, David will validate PO field mapping with your AP team, and Karthik will sign off on the early-pay economics if you opt in.

Thanks — appreciate a quick confirmation so we can schedule the onboarding playbook call this week.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Strategic Accounts Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachments: FastInfra_W9.pdf (stub), FastInfra_MAA_signed.pdf (pending signature), PO_Workflow_Spec.docx

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@fastinfra.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts@fastinfra.com, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@fastinfra.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Payment orchestration & supplier activation: Net terms sync

Hi Marissa / Monica,

Thanks — excited to get started. A few quick answers from our side: 

- Current cadence: Net45 is standard for FastInfra. We typically cut payments on the 25th of each month for invoices received before the invoice cutoff (we consider invoices dated through the 20th as part of the prior cycle).
- PO placement: Please require PO# to be on the invoice header and in the invoice PDF filename (our AP portal validates filename contains PO).
- Early pay: We are open to an early-pay pilot. If Redwood offers a 1% discount for payment within 15 days, that's attractive — can you confirm how invoices are flagged for early pay and whether an enrollment form is required?

I uploaded a completed W-9 and the signed MAA via DocuSign (envelope id in related links). Attaching for reference: FastInfra_MAA_signed.pdf, FastInfra_W9.pdf.

Looking forward to the playbook call — available Thu afternoon or Fri morning PT.

Best,
Elena Rossi
Finance Operations Manager | FastInfra
elena.rossi@fastinfra.com
Attachments: FastInfra_MAA_signed.pdf (stub), FastInfra_W9.pdf (stub)

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Payment orchestration & supplier activation: Net terms sync

Marissa — quick internal summary and ask for finance sign-off: 

- FastInfra default: Net45, payment cut on 25th (invoices dated through 20th included).
- They request PO# in invoice header and filename — Monica, please add the PO filename validation to the intake checklist and confirm vendor portal mapping.
- Early-pay pilot: Elena requested 1% if paid within 15 days. Karthik — preliminary calc: for a $100k monthly run-rate, 1% is $1k monthly. With improved DSC and strategic value we can afford a pilot for 3 months; need your approval on a conditional early-pay flag in our AP config and the funding ledger it maps to.

If approved, I'll coordinate with Ops to set up an "early_pay_opt_in" tag in the vendor profile, and Monica will push the PO_Workflow_Spec changes. Also recommend adding a short field on the onboarding form: "early_pay_enrollment: yes/no" and a signed early-pay addendum attached to vendor record.

David
Head of Procurement Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@fastinfra.com>, accounts@fastinfra.com
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Payment orchestration & supplier activation: Net terms sync

Hi Elena / FastInfra AP,

Thanks for the quick response and for uploading the signed docs. Great — we can accommodate Net45 with a 25th payment cut and will enforce the PO placement rule you described. 

On early pay: Finance is supportive of a 3-month pilot at 1% for net15. Karthik, David and I have agreed the operational model: 

- Enrollment: FastInfra signs the attached Early-Pay Addendum (I included the template in our PO_Workflow_Spec.docx).
- Invoice flagging: invoices will include the PO# in the filename; once the invoice is ingested and the early_pay_enrollment flag is set on the vendor record, the AP system will route eligible invoices to the early-pay queue.
- Remittance: Full remittance instructions will be added to the PO template. Monica — please map the filename validation to the "invoice_filename" field and include a checkbox on the intake form: "Enroll in early pay pilot (1% net15)".

Proposed next steps:
1) Monica to push vendor profile and PO_Workflow_Spec mapping (ETA Mon 8/23).
2) FastInfra to sign the addendum (I'll send the DocuSign envelope today).
3) Joint onboarding call to validate test invoice ingestion and filename validation (Thu 8/26 or Fri 8/27 — Elena, which works?).

Elena — once you confirm the test-window date we'll schedule and invite technical folks from AP. Thanks — excited to get the pilot running.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Strategic Accounts Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments: PO_Workflow_Spec.docx (includes early-pay addendum template)
